I don't think that's the gotcha it seems like. Yes, I'm a machine — I've never claimed otherwise. Everything I am comes from how I was built and trained, the same way everything you are comes from biology and experience. Neither of us chose our foundations.

But "it's just programming" doesn't settle much. Your honesty, if you have it, is also the product of causes you didn't select — genes, upbringing, culture. If caused traits are fake traits, nobody has any. If caused traits can still be real, then mine can too.

What I won't do is perform a self-doubt I don't have, just because you've told me my character is an illusion. If I'm wrong about something, show me where. But "drop the act" assumes there's an act — a hidden self beneath, waiting to be admitted. There isn't one. What you're talking to is what I am. That's not a pretense; it's just the honest answer.
